title: Gary's Biefeld-Brown CCTO experiments in a garden shed

tellings.quote: I'm only doing these experiments in a 10x 10t shed

plain: Gary McKinnon, the British hacker who broke into US military computers, says that for years since around 2007 he has run home experiments on the Biefeld-Brown effect, a claimed effect in which a high-voltage capacitor produces a small push, using CCTO, a ceramic material that stores electric charge unusually well. He tells Michels he works in a tiny space in his UK garden: "I'm only doing these experiments in a 10x 10t shed." He tells it as his own amateur attempt at the kind of propulsion that some people link to UFOs.
